matchups.narrativeAngle: This is a theme pairing, not a canonical duel. Official Magic story frames Gisa and Geralf as rival sibling necromancers with undead armies; Sedris's official card record frames him as a Zombie Warrior who gives creature cards unearth. The contrast is persistent Zombie recursion versus temporary, hasty graveyard returns—not a claim that these characters meet in a published story.

comboSpotlights.comboName: Rooftop Storm + Gravecrawler + Ashnod's Altar + Diregraf Captain
comboSpotlights.typeLabel: Repeatable loop · infinite mana and death triggers

cards.name: Gravecrawler
cards.role: Recurs from the graveyard while you control a Zombie
cards.where: separate source sideboard; not in source main

comboSpotlights.sequence: With Rooftop Storm and Diregraf Captain on the battlefield, cast Gravecrawler from the graveyard for {0}; Diregraf Captain is a Zombie, meeting Gravecrawler's condition. Sacrifice Gravecrawler to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}; Diregraf Captain triggers when another Zombie dies. Recast Gravecrawler and repeat. This can make arbitrarily large colorless mana and death triggers, subject to the normal game rules and legal targets.
comboSpotlights.caveat: Rules-text checked, not playtested or format-certified. Gravecrawler is in the saved source sideboard, separate from the main list; this line is not evidence that the current main list already contains the complete package. The source itself is a Vintage-labeled over-target candidate pool.

comboSpotlights.comboName: Thrumming Stone + Shadowborn Apostle + Eater of Hope

cards.name: Shadowborn Apostle
cards.role: Sacrifice six Apostles to find a Demon

comboSpotlights.sequence: With Thrumming Stone on the battlefield, cast Shadowborn Apostle. Ripple 4 may reveal and let you cast more Apostles without paying their mana costs. Once six Apostles are on the battlefield, pay {B} and sacrifice them to an Apostle's ability to search for a Demon; Eater of Hope is a listed source-main target. This is a conditional tutor/value engine, not an infinite loop or guaranteed line.
comboSpotlights.caveat: Every named card is in source main, but the archive list and proposal are not playtested or legality-certified. Ripple depends on the top four cards; the line needs six Apostles, black mana, Thrumming Stone, and a Demon target. The public source record does not confirm a commander.

cards.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
cards.role: Copies a spell that targets only Zada
cards.where: source main; not a confirmed source commander

comboSpotlights.sequence: Control Zada and at least one other eligible creature. Cast Twinflame with X=1 targeting only Zada. Zada copies it for each other eligible creature and retargets each copy; the original and copies create hasty token copies. Exile those tokens at the beginning of the next end step. This is a finite burst, not an infinite combo.
comboSpotlights.caveat: Both cards are in the saved source main, but the list is Legacy-labeled, has 64 main / 0 sideboard copies, and is below its 100-card contextual target. The review proposes a Zada command-zone move, but the source does not establish a commander; the review remains untested and count arithmetic is not a legality audit. The exact title-level Robogles credit is preserved; no author, playtest, or endorsement is claimed.
